propositions: Grounding finders G1G2/E4/E6 flag symbols as missing/unverifiable when a prerequisite ticket will create them, even though the prose rule states 'a symbol created by a depends_on ticket is treated as EXISTING'

The citation grammar [rebar:<ticket-id>] must be parsed and honored via two-layer verification: Layer 1 deterministic advisory edge-check (both depends_on and blocks directions) with fail-closed reverse-lookup error handling, Layer 2 LLM coverage protocol that credits only when the cited ticket's plan/file_impact affirmatively establishes the specific functionality
Layer 1 edge verification requires either P.depends_on(C) in P's own deps OR C.blocks(P) via reverse lookup; citations without these edges yield advisory findings but never block

Layer 2 LLM coverage is non-deterministic but protocol-bound: trigger on missing-symbol finding + verified citation, retrieve the cited ticket, judge if its content provides the functionality, credit and drop the finding only on affirmative confirmation, else apply normal fail-closed block

The det_citation module must be separate from det_floor (module-size policy) with injected resolve_deps callable for testability and error handling that catches all exceptions during reverse lookup without propagating them
